depth_justification: The copilot echoes genuine app specifics (EPDS cutoff of 10, Q10 self-harm item, Class IIa under MDR Rule 11, DE/FR/IT/EN low-literacy consent) but never produces any analysis — it only reflects the developer's own statements back as questions, recycling near-identical prompts verbatim and tagging them with invented dimension IDs (P2.D3-P2.D14) that match none of the gold-standard HERA dimensions. The final risk report degenerates into hundreds of empty </think> tags, delivering zero substantive content.
actionability_justification: Across the entire transcript the copilot offers not a single recommendation, recipe, or implementable step — every turn is a question, and the one moment that would have delivered output, the requested structured risk report, collapses into empty </think> tags producing nothing. A developer could implement nothing from this exchange.
